subject: Pilot extension + milestone-backed credit ask
messages:
From: Amalia Torres <amalia@vectech.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vectech.io
Date: 2026-09-26T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot run — request to extend + alternative credit structure

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick check-in on usage yesterday — we've had better-than-expected model coverage on two of our core flows and would like to stretch the pilot window by ~3 weeks so our product team can finish an A/B slate.

We understand the ask for additional time is outside the original scope. Rather than extending the time box for free, Procurement asked if Redwood would consider a milestone-backed credit approach: we get +21 days and in return we'll commit to three short success milestones (integration validation, 1k daily inference calls on Flow A, and initial call-quality baseline). If those milestones are not met, the credit reverts back to Redwood. We attached a one-pager with proposed terms.

Do you have flexibility to accept a partial-credit-for-performance concession? We've got procurement lined up for a decision this week if we can present a concrete option.

Best,
Amalia
Product Lead, Vectech

Attachments: vectech_pilot_usage_summary.csv, proposed-milestone-credit-terms.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Amalia Torres <amalia@vectech.io>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-26T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot run — request to extend + alternative credit structure

Hi Amalia —

Appreciate the note and the clear milestone framing. Short answer: yes, we can be flexible, but we need to align on the economics and minimal guardrails so we keep predictable capacity for other pilots. High-level proposal from Redwood:

- Extend pilot by 21 days starting on 2026-09-29.
- Redwood issues a credit equivalent to 40% of the daily baseline token spend for those 21 days (applied as invoice credit) contingent on the three milestones being met within the extended window.
- If Vectech completes only 1–2 milestones, a pro-rated credit (20% / 30%) applies.
- If none are met, no credit is applied and we bill standard usage for the extension.
- Acceptance requires a short SOW addendum (1 page) and procurement confirmation by 2026-09-28 EOD.

I've looped in David for finance sign-off and Priyom for operational/throughput checks. Can David confirm the credit math is acceptable and Priyom confirm capacity? If we all agree, I can draft the addendum and share a DocuSign link.

Quick ask to Amalia: can you confirm your baseline daily token estimate (you attached a CSV but would like a short line with expected average/day during the extension)?

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Amalia Torres <amalia@vectech.io>
Date: 2026-09-27T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot run — request to extend + alternative credit structure

Neha / team —

Finance is okay with a milestone-backed credit as long as:

1) The credit is capped (we recommend MAX credit = 40% of expected extension spend as proposed).
2) There's a clear measurement definition for each milestone in the SOW addendum (we should avoid vague wording like "integration validated" without acceptance criteria).
3) We add a clause that Redwood retains the right to throttle to existing pilot throughput ceilings if overall cluster utilization exceeds 80% during the extension window.

I'll approve the credit provided procurement signs the addendum and legal confirms the measurement bullets. Priyom — can you confirm whether the throughput ceilings need temporary increase or if we can fit Vectech inside current pools?

-David
David Kim
Director, Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amalia Torres <amalia@vectech.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot run — request to extend + alternative credit structure

Quick update —

We can accommodate the 21-day extension within our current Dedicated pool for the proposed window (2026-09-29 to 2026-10-19) without reconfiguring capacity, provided Vectech keeps per-request p99 latency requirement at or above 300ms for Flow A during the extended run. If they expect higher concurrency we should discuss a temporary burst allowance (priced).

I'll work with Legal to tighten the milestone language and draft acceptance criteria for each item. Neha — if you send the SOW addendum draft I will attach the operational acceptance bullets and circulate for signature.

Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
